    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    long long x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    long double ratio = (long double)x / (long double)y;
    pair<long long, long long> answer;

    for (long long b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {

        }
        if (diff_ceil < min_diff) {
            min_diff = diff_ceil;
            answer = {a_ceil, b};
        }
    }
    cout << answer.first << "/" << answer.second;
    return 0;
}
